candidate.answerReason: There are twelve positive factors of 60, and six of them are less than 7, giving probability 6/12 = 1/2.

methods.label: List the factor pairs
methods.explanation:
Factor pairs provide an organized way to find every positive factor of \(60\). The smaller member of a pair is at most \(7\), since two integers at least \(8\) would have product at least \(64\). Each number from \(1\) through \(6\) divides \(60\), while \(7\) does not. Thus all the factor pairs are
\[
(1,60),\ (2,30),\ (3,20),
\]
\[
(4,15),\ (5,12),\ (6,10).
\]
These pairs contain twelve different factors. Exactly six, namely \(1,2,3,4,5,6\), are less than \(7\). Each factor is equally likely to be drawn, so the probability is
\[
\frac{6}{12}=\boxed{\frac12},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
methods.levelReason: Listing factor pairs and counting equally likely outcomes use elementary divisibility and fractions.
